acceptance_contract.bounds: Preserve original sample endpoints. Accept only 0 < region_size <= original sample_span OR region_size == independently owned-file-bound __TEXT.vmsize. Reject intermediate oversized or rounded bounds.
acceptance_contract.per_image_geometry: Fresh exact selected artifact for every image; C independently decodes the held owned descriptor, Python independently streams full SHA/identity and bounded fixed-width header/load commands. Thin LE ARM64 executable/dylib only; one __TEXT and LC_UUID; exact framing/count/section tables; UUID matches inventory/sample.
acceptance_contract.narrow_geometry: fileoff0; positive sample_span <= filesize == vmsize <= artifact bytes; full header and command table within __TEXT.filesize; preferred vmaddr+vmsize and runtime sample_start+vmsize do not wrap; initprot5, maxprot5/7, flags0. No assumed vmaddr0.
acceptance_contract.preserved_safeguards: Native structure/return width, same start, no zero/wrapping extent, offset0, RX/nonwrite/non-submap, independently bound kernel max5/7, exact canonical path/vnode/device/inode/size/UID, pre/post descriptor/file custody and full hashes, helper integrity, target audit-token/lifetime, every selected image required, no native-interval overlap.
acceptance_contract.custody_addition: C rechecks lstat/canonical path after bounded descriptor parsing and before query; retains FD through post-query checks, closes every owned FD. Runner brackets slow pre/post artifact/helper hash work with target checks.
acceptance_contract.closed_output: Success schema2 adds primitive artifact_text/UUID, extent_kind, device/inode/UID. Python derives kind and compares geometry/hash/identity; numeric booleans fail. Original failure schema1 and failure-only B28 diagnostic remain separate.
acceptance_contract.prohibited_shortcuts: No rounding/page-size inference, arbitrary allowance, extra external tool cycle, fallback, or mapped-memory/page-hash claim.
